name: service-desk-v21
description: Service Desk v21 cloud UAT baseline with family-specific SLA assignments, Standard Bank direct-to-L3 support, Danske SaaS flows, engagement-manager portfolios, 180 historical requests, redesigned Filters, richer FAQ, request-context banners, and calendar-pulse dashboards.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,org,identity,request -c white,green,yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @service-desk/web" "npm run dev -w @service-desk/organization-service" "npm run dev -w @service-desk/identity-service" "npm run dev -w @service-desk/request-service"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n web,org,identity,request -c white,green,yellow,cyan "npm run start -w @service-desk/web" "npm run start -w @service-desk/organization-service" "npm run start -w @service-desk/identity-service" "npm run start -w @service-desk/request-service"
